states.claim: e->song.pat[j] is a pattern object whose effectRows field bounds the effect loop for channel j.
patChanX[j] is assigned the current cursor X position for each visible channel j, and patChanX[chans] is assigned after the channel loop.
demandX is assigned the current cursor X position when a cursor cell is rendered.

values.claim: Row index i is validated to be in [0, e->song.patLen) before any pat->data[i] access.
Order index ord is validated to be in [0, e->song.ordersLen) before use.
Column loop index j runs from 0 to chans-1, and patCache[j] and e->song.chanShow[j] are indexed within that range.
j32 is j*32, and selection comparisons use j32, j32+1, j32+2 against sel1XSum/sel2XSum.
Effect loop index k runs from 0 to e->song.pat[j].effectRows-1, and index=4+(k<<1) is used to access pat->data[i][index] and pat->data[i][index+1].
Instrument value pat->data[i][2] is checked against [0, e->song.insLen) before indexing e->song.ins.
